g.text: Median (IQR); n = 528/200 tumour and 72/168 normal libraries; 4 of 4 unpaired rank-sum tests at FDR < 0.05. The
unpaired contrast mixes tissue with plate in 2 of 4 rows: in TCGA-KIRC the non-feature difference falls from
1.73 percentage points unpaired to 0.15 on the plates both tissues occupy (144 tumour and 67 normal libraries,
rank-sum p 0.057) for the normals of the analysed tumours, the figure the text quotes (0.16, p 0.049, on the 68
plate-matched libraries of all normal libraries, which is the set these bars show), and is 0.15 within patient
Library metrics in tumour and matched normal libraries
CPTAC-3 normal: rho 0.35 (n = 129); CPTAC-3 tumour: rho 0.54 (n = 129); TCGA-KIRC normal: rho
The projected lncRNA axis in paired libraries
4 sample sets; open grey points and bars are the median
and range of the PC1 share of 200 size-matched random
subsets of the discovery samples (6 of 8 rows); 3
observed shares sit above that range; a share carries no
sign, and the orientation of 3 of these 8 components is a
convention, so only their magnitudes are quoted elsewhere

patients, 26-28 deaths; faded where events per parameter
